transcript:
Speaker A: Aapke papa kahan hain? [Where is your father?] 
Speaker B: My dad is out of station. 
Speaker A: Is sentence ko correct kijiye. Out of station galat phrase hai. Aapko out of town kehna chahiye. [Correct this sentence. Out of station is a wrong phrase. You should say out of town.] 
Speaker B: Kya? Dono mein kya farq hai? [What? What's the difference between the two?] 
Speaker A: Out of station ka real matlab ye hota hai ki wo kisi railway station ke bahar hain. Agar wo kisi doosre sehar gaye hain, to sahi English hogi: My dad is out of town. [The real meaning of out of station is that they are outside some railway station. If they have gone to another city, the correct English will be: My dad is out of town.] 
Speaker B: Oh, theek hai, theek hai. Vani, mujhe English acche se nahi aati, isliye itni galtiyan hoti hain. [Oh, okay, okay. Vani, I don't know English well, that's why I make so many mistakes.] 
Speaker A: Galtiyan hona swabhavik hai, lekin unhe sudharna zaroori hai. Kya aapne kabhi SpeakEasy par AI teacher ke saath practice karne ka socha hai? [Making mistakes is natural, but correcting them is important. Have you ever thought of practicing with an AI teacher on SpeakEasy?] 
Speaker B: AI teacher? Wo to mehenge hote honge na? [AI teacher? They must be expensive, right?] 
Speaker A: Yeh ek galatfehmi hai. Normal English coaching classes ke muqable, SpeakEasy saat guna sasta hai. Isi quality aur affordability ki wajah se yahan mere saath 1 crore se zyada log jud kar seekh rahe hain. [This is a misconception. Compared to normal English coaching classes, SpeakEasy is seven times cheaper. Because of this quality and affordability, more than 1 crore people are learning with me here.] 
Speaker B: Par mere paas practice ke liye time bhi nahi milta. [But I don't even get time to practice.] 
Speaker A: Iske liye aapko alag se time nikaalne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Roz ki sirf 15-20 minute ki practice kaafi hai. Aap apne schedule ke hisaab se kahin bhi seekh sakte hain. [You don't need to take out separate time for this. Just 15-20 minutes of daily practice is enough. You can learn anywhere according to your schedule.] 
Speaker B: Wow, kaise join karun? [Wow, how do I join?] 
Speaker A: Neeche diye gaye install button par click kijiye aur SpeakEasy app download kijiye. Sirf 15 dino ke niyamit abhyas se aap mein ek bada improvement dikhne lagega. Install now par click karo aur SpeakEasy app download karo. [Click on the install button given below and download the SpeakEasy app. With just 15 days of regular practice, you will start seeing a big improvement. Click on Install Now and download the SpeakEasy app.]
